governance.dynamicTenderContent: Never translate automatically; retain the source-language record.

tender.note: Do not substitute RFQ unless the source says RFQ.

rfq.definition: A buyer request inviting suppliers to submit quotations.

quote.definition: A supplier's commercial response to an RFQ.
quote.note: Keep distinct from bid and tender.

buyer.definition: The organisation procuring goods or services.

supplier.definition: The organisation offering goods or services.

verification.definition: A recorded check of supplier information or evidence.

compliance.definition: Conformity with an applicable requirement; do not imply legal approval.

specific_goals.definition: Tender-specific goals defined by the buyer; not a universal B-BBEE lookup.

preference_points.definition: Points allocated under the tender's stated preference system.

closing_date.definition: The deadline for a procurement response.

original_source.definition: The authoritative external listing from which an opportunity was obtained.
